```{r, warning=F}
load("myrefData2.Rdata") # 933 elites 
gam1 = -myrefData2$colcoord[,1]
plot(density(gam1))
# plot(density(scale(gam1)))
gam1 = gam1 / (max(gam1) - min(gam1))

# Define new_gamma as the 2nd eigenvector of (yty+WtW)
new_gamma = -scale(eigen(comb_lap_new)$vec[,2]) 
new_gamma = new_gamma / (max(new_gamma) - min(new_gamma))

yty_gamma = -scale(eigen(lap_yty)$vec[,2])
yty_gamma = yty_gamma / (max(yty_gamma) - min(yty_gamma))

# Density of new_gamma
plot(density(new_gamma))
plot(density(yty_gamma))

# Compare gam1 from CA and new_gamma

# plot(gam1, new_gamma, ylim=c(-3.5,4))
# abline(h=0,v=0)
# points(gam1,yty_gamma,col="red")
ggplot(data = NULL) + geom_point(aes(x=gam1, y=new_gamma), color = "Blue", alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=gam1, y=yty_gamma), color = "Red", alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0) + 
  labs(x = expression(" CA estimated "~gamma), y = expression(" New "~gamma))


# Compare 2nd eigenvector from only yty and new_gamma
# plot(yty_gamma, new_gamma)
# abline(a=0,b=1)
ggplot(data = NULL) + geom_point(aes(x=yty_gamma, y=new_gamma)) + geom_abline(slope = 1) + labs(x = expression(" Without Text Improved "~gamma), y = expression(" Text Improved "~gamma))

ggplot(data = NULL) + geom_point(aes(x=yty_gamma, y=new_gamma)) + geom_abline(slope = 1) + xlim(-0.2,0.2) + ylim(-0.25,0.25)


ggplot(data = NULL) + geom_density(aes(x=gam1)) + 
  geom_density(aes(x=new_gamma), color = "Blue") + 
  geom_density(aes(x=yty_gamma), color = "Red")

c(min(gam1), max(gam1))
c(min(new_gamma), max(new_gamma))
c(min(yty_gamma), max(yty_gamma))
```


```{r,fig.width=12}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(gam1, new_gamma, ylim = c(-0.5,0.6))
plot(gam1, yty_gamma, ylim = c(-0.5,0.6))
```

# standardize


```{r}
compare = data.frame("elite" = factor(myrefData2$colnames), "gamma" = gam1, "new_gamma"=new_gamma, "yty_gamma"=yty_gamma)

compare = compare %>% mutate(diff = new_gamma - yty_gamma)

compare = left_join(compare, elite_info %>% mutate(elite = id_str) %>% select(elite, name), by = "elite") 

hist(compare$diff, breaks = 15)

ggplot(compare, aes(x=elite, y = diff, color = diff < -0.05)) + geom_point() + theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank()) 


```


```{r, fig.width=12}
big_change_elite = elite_info %>% filter(id_str %in% as.vector(compare[compare$diff <= -0.05, ]$elite))

big_change_elite_id = which(factor(myrefData2$colnames) %in% big_change_elite$id_str)



new_ip = data.frame(id_str = factor(myrefData2$colnames)[big_change_elite_id], new_gamma = new_gamma[big_change_elite_id],
name = (elite_info %>% filter(id_str %in% factor(myrefData2$colnames)[big_change_elite_id]))$name)

old_ip = data.frame(id_str = factor(myrefData2$colnames)[big_change_elite_id], gam1 = gam1[big_change_elite_id],
name = (elite_info %>% filter(id_str %in% factor(myrefData2$colnames)[big_change_elite_id]))$name)

five_elites = c("Hillary Clinton", "BBC News (World)", "Fox News", "Joe Biden", "Bernie Sanders", "Mike Pence", "Ted Cruz", "Tucker Carlson")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(
ggplot(data=NULL) + 
  geom_point(aes(factor(myrefData2$colnames), new_gamma), alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(data = new_ip, aes(id_str, new_gamma), color = "red", size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = new_ip %>% filter(name %in% five_elites),  aes(id_str, new_gamma), 
            label = (new_ip %>% filter(name %in% five_elites))$name, 
            color = "black", vjust = -1, size = 3) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank())  + labs(x = "", y = expression(" Text Improved "~gamma)) 
,
ggplot(data=NULL) + 
  geom_point(aes(factor(myrefData2$colnames), gam1), alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(data = old_ip, aes(id_str, gam1), color = "red", size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = old_ip %>% filter(name %in% five_elites),  aes(id_str, gam1), 
            label = (old_ip %>% filter(name %in% five_elites))$name, 
            color = "black", vjust = -1, size = 3)+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank())  + labs(x = "", y = expression(" CA estimated "~gamma))
)
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
# Define the blue and red colors
blue_color <- "#0000FF"
red_color <- "#FF0000"

# Create the blue and red color palette
color_palette <- c(blue_color, "chartreuse3", red_color)

compare2 = read.csv("compare_add.csv")
compare2$elite = as.character(compare$elite)
compare2 = compare2 %>% filter(elite != "216776631")
gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  ggplot(data=compare2) + 
  geom_point(aes(elite, gamma, color = party), alpha = 0.4) + 
  geom_point(data = compare2 %>% filter(name %in% five_elites),  aes(elite, gamma), 
             color = "orange", size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(data = compare2 %>% filter(name %in% five_elites),  aes(elite, gamma, label = name), 
            color = "black", vjust = -0.1, hjust = 1.1, size = 5) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank())  + 
    scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
    labs(x = "", y = expression(" CA estimated "~gamma), color = "Party Alignment")
  # + ylim(-0.5, 0.55)
,
ggplot(data=compare2) + 
  geom_point(aes(elite, new_gamma, color = party), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = compare2 %>% filter(name %in% five_elites), aes(elite, new_gamma), 
             color = "orange", size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(data = compare2 %>% filter(name %in% five_elites),  aes(elite, new_gamma, label = name), 
            color = "black",  vjust = -0.1, hjust = 1.1, size = 5) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank())  + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
  labs(x = "", y = expression(" Text Improved "~gamma), color = "Party Alignment") 
# + ylim(-0.5, 0.55)
)

compare2 %>% filter(party == "D", gamma >= 0)  
compare2 %>% filter(party == "R", gamma <= 0)  

compare2 %>% filter(party == "D", new_gamma >= 0)  
compare2 %>% filter(party == "R", new_gamma <= 0)   

(compare2 %>% filter(is.na(party)) %>% select(name))$name
```

p2 = ggplot(data=compare2) +

  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank())  +

                     name = "Party Alignment",

plt_legend <- lemon::g_legend(p0 +  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1)))

gridExtra::grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(p1 + theme(legend.position="none"),
